notes.title: Appreciation post
notes.content:
[p]I just want to say a huge thank you to everyone who played [i]Analog - Skin Off[/i].
It’s honestly such a pleasure seeing people take the time to play, leave reviews, and even make videos about it. I couldn’t have asked for more.[/p][p]I know the game isn’t perfect, and that’s exactly why your feedback means so much to me. I read every single review — what you liked, what didn’t work — and I take it all into account.[/p][p]With your feedback and everything I learned from making this game, the next title in the series  "[i]Analog - MIRROR[/i]" will be my best work yet. It’s already halfway done, and I’m incredibly excited about it.[/p][p]If you're looking forward to it, your wishlists really matter — they’re the best way to support me right now.[/p][p]Thank you again for playing, reviewing, and being part of this.[/p][p]— Nikos[/p]
